variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened.
variants.body:
The leader of {party} is being challenged. The challenge places authority within the organisation in question, without deciding who should exercise it. Readers assessing {target} should distinguish the opening of a contest from an outcome that has not been established by this report.

An argument over leadership deserves workers' attention when it concerns whose needs a party represents. It deserves rather less admiration as a quarrel over a title. Labour should keep asking about work and daily life, rather than choosing a side on the strength of an internal contest alone.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
